projects.appDescription: Moment Pro Camera II is an iPhone camera app with manual controls for settings like exposure, shutter speed, and ISO. These features aren’t always obvious when you first open the app, so I built the full onboarding guide to help users discover them and learn how to use them.

projects.title: Onboarding Guide & Action Plate Customization
projects.description:
The main challenge was highlighting controls that users can rearrange in the Action Plate. The guide needed to find each control in its current position, rather than rely on fixed coordinates, so it would still work with a customized layout.

I built the Action Plate Browser, where users can choose between different Action Plates and customize each one by changing its color and rearranging or removing controls.

Some Action Plates have controls with custom shapes, which made their UI more challenging to implement. I used SwiftUI’s Path API to draw those shapes.

projects.appDescription: HungerStation is a leading food delivery app in Saudi Arabia and part of Delivery Hero.

projects.title: Order Details Redesign & App Responsiveness
projects.description:
As part of the Post Order squad, I implemented much of the Order Details redesign, including the map header’s scroll behavior and the navigation bar transition. I also improved scrolling performance by using the Animation Hitches instrument to identify and resolve rendering bottlenecks.

On the Foundation team, I proposed and led an initiative to reduce production app hangs. I improved app hang observability by enriching Sentry reports with stack traces, making it easier to identify root causes. I prioritized issues by user impact, implemented fixes, and coordinated work across the team. I monitored each fix in production and continued iterating until we reached our hang-free rate target.

The main challenge was that most hangs were difficult to reproduce in development. Some also originated in third-party libraries, which required finding workarounds when a direct fix wasn’t possible.

projects.appDescription: The Sainsbury’s grocery app helps customers shop for groceries on their phone.

projects.title: Voice-based shopping lists
projects.description: I built a voice-based shopping list feature that turns a recording into a structured list with AI. Users describe what they need instead of typing each item.
